title: RevolveFeature
description: Parametric Revolve feature: rotates a sketch profile around an axis by an angle to create a solid.

angle.description: Revolve angle in degrees: numeric value or parameter name / expression string

axis.description: Optional axis direction vector (defaults to sketch plane Y-axis / [0,1,0])

axis_origin.description: Optional point on the axis (defaults to sketch plane origin)

symmetric.description: If true, revolve equally in both directions (angle is total)

operation.description: Boolean operation intent (currently only 'new' is implemented)

segments.description: Number of facets used when approximating the solid of revolution
